title: API Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

**Job Summary**  
We are seeking a skilled API Test Automation Engineer with hands-on expertise in Karate  
Framework, REST API Testing, Automation, and CSIRT/Security Testing. The ideal  
candidate will be responsible for validating API functionality, performance, authentication  
mechanisms, and security compliance while ensuring high-quality releases through  
automation and continuous testing practices.  
The role requires close collaboration with Development, DevOps, Security, and  
Architecture teams to identify quality and security risks early in the SDLC and support  
secure application delivery.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**API Testing & Automation**  

* Design, develop, and execute API test cases based on business and technical

requirements.  

* Build, enhance, and maintain API automation frameworks using Karate Framework.
* Validate REST APIs, request/response payloads, status codes, headers, data

integrity, and API workflows.  

* Perform API sequencing and end-to-end integration testing.
* Develop reusable automated test scripts and test data management strategies.

**Security & CSIRT Testing**  

* Conduct CSIRT-related API security validation activities.
* Validate authentication, authorization, access control, and token management

mechanisms.  

* Perform vulnerability verification and security regression testing.
* Assess API security risks and validate remediation fixes.
* Verify adherence to OWASP API security best practices.

**Quality Assurance & Release Testing**  

* Execute SIT, E2E, Regression, UAT support, and Release Validation testing.
* Identify, log, track, and manage defects through closure.
* Analyze test execution results and prepare quality reports.
* Support release readiness assessments and production deployment validation.

**CI/CD & DevOps Integration**  

* Integrate API automation suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Support continuous testing initiatives.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to improve automated quality gates.
* Ensure test execution and reporting are aligned with Agile delivery practices.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Communication**  

* Work closely with Developers, Architects, Security Teams, and Product Owners.
* Participate in requirement reviews and test strategy discussions.
* Provide risk assessments and actionable testing insights.
* Drive quality improvements across the software delivery lifecycle.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

 **Work Experience**  

**API Testing**  

* REST API Testing
* API Automation
* JSON
* XML
* API Validation
* End-to-End Testing

**Automation Tools**  

* Karate Framework (Mandatory)
* Postman
* CURL
* Swagger/OpenAPI

**Security Testing**  

* CSIRT Testing
* Authentication Testing
* Authorization Testing
* Access Control Validation
* Vulnerability Verification
* Security Regression Testing

**API Security**  

* OAuth
* JWT
* API Security Testing
* OWASP API Security Principles

**QA & Defect Management**  

* SIT Testing
* Regression Testing
* Release Validation
* Defect Tracking & Management

**DevOps & CI/CD**  

* CI/CD Integration
* Automated Testing Pipelines
* Agile Methodology

title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Test Automation Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Use quality processes, automation tools, and methodologies to transform testing products and solutions. Run end-to-end quality engineering function with a focus on automation to improve control, accuracy and integrity.
  
**Must have skills :** Veeva CRM testing  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **2** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:  
As a Veeva CRM Tester, a typical day involves designing and executing testing for implementations, integrations, and releases in a regulated life sciences environment. The role owns test preparation, execution, defect investigation, validation evidence, and delivery of high-quality results. This position focuses on ensuring quality, compliance, traceability, and release readiness across Veeva CRM programs while collaborating with cross-functional teams, supporting testing best practices, and contributing to continuous improvement in testing processes and automation.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:  

* Analyze requirements and prepare test scenarios, cases, data, and traceability.
* Execute functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, mobile, data migration, and UAT testing.
* Validate Veeva CRM commercial processes, Salesforce configurations, integrations, and offline scenarios.
* Record clear evidence, identify and report defects, perform retesting, and support root-cause analysis.
* Maintain GxP, CSV, data integrity, privacy, security, and audit-ready documentation.
* Coordinate with business, development, validation, and support teams to resolve issues.
* Report progress, risks, blockers, and test results to the Test Lead.
* Support junior testers, peer reviews, automation, regression optimization, and reusable assets.
* Own test execution activities with a strong focus on accuracy, risk awareness, and quality outcomes.
* Support defect analysis, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure on-time completion of assigned testing, validation evidence, timely identification and communication of issues, and effective retesting activities.
* Deliver strong coverage, traceability, defect quality, reduced escaped defects, and improved regression efficiency.

  
Professional & Technical Skills:  

* Must Have Skills: Hands-on Veeva CRM testing experience in a life sciences environment.
* Secondary skills include Veeva CRM, Salesforce, ISTQB, or Agile certification.
* Experience testing Veeva CRM in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical-device, or life sciences environments.
* Good knowledge of accounts, calls, consent, Approved Email, CLM, events, samples, territories, and mobile/offline functionality.
* Experience in test analysis, design, execution, defect management, traceability, data validation, integration testing, and UAT support.
* Ability to write clear test cases, query data, validate interfaces, analyze defects, and produce audit-ready evidence.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, ALM/Quality Center, Zephyr, or equivalent tools.
* Exposure to Selenium, Cucumber, Tosca, or similar automation tools.
* Understanding of Agile delivery, GxP, CSV, ALCOA+, data integrity, and validation controls.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, collaboration, and communication skills.
* Strong learning agility, stakeholder collaboration, and effective communication skills.
* Experience with Veeva Commercial Cloud, CLM, Approved Email, Align, MyInsights, or iOS offline testing is preferred.
* Exposure to API, database, automation, performance, accessibility, and security testing is preferred.

  
Additional Information:  

* The candidate should have 2-4 years of software testing or quality engineering experience, including at least 1 years of hands-on Veeva CRM testing.
* Bachelor s degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent experience.
* This is based at our Accenture Office

  
15 years full time education

title: Hardware Test Automation Engineer
description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

We are seeking a **Hardware Test Automation Engineer** to support the validation and quality assurance of consumer electronics products. In this role, you will develop and maintain Python-based test automation, integrate lab equipment into automated test environments.

This position is ideal for an engineer with a strong technical foundation who is eager to deepen expertise in hardware-focused test automation.

**Your Contribution:**

In this role you will:

* Support the deployment, maintenance, and improvement of Python-based test frameworks.

* Understand and follow detailed test plans and procedures to validate products.
* Troubleshoot failures in test scripts, hardware setups, and electronic interfaces
* Integrate AI-based solutions into test automation when relevant.
* Document test procedures, results, and contribute to clear and maintainable documentation.
* Collaborate with validation engineers to ensure test coverage and product quality.
Learn and apply best practices in test design, automation, and quality assurance.  

**Key Qualifications:**  
For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and behaviors to our team:

Programming & Automation

* 2-4 years of experience in software testing, automation, or embedded systems validation.
* Solid knowledge of Python programming basics.
* Experience with the Pytest framework is preferred.
Familiarity with Git  

Hardware & Electronics

* Knowledge of Electronics Engineering fundamentals.
* Hands-on assembly and wiring of electronic test benches, including integration of sensors, connectors, and harnesses.
Debugging and troubleshooting of electronic circuits, signal integrity, and connectivity issues.  

Test & Validation

* Interest in embedded systems testing and automation tools.
* Exposure to manual and automated testing methodologies.
Ability to understand and execute detailed test plans and procedures.  

Tools & Protocols

* Proficiency with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, USB analysers, power supplies, multimeter, etc.
Familiarity with communication protocols such as UART, USB, Ethernet, Bluetooth.  

Soft Skills

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English.
A team player with a willingness to learn and take guidance from senior engineers.  

Preferable skills

* Experience with AI agent for engineering task
* Experience in product validation for Consumer electronics
ISTQB Certification  

  

**Education**

Bachelors in Electronics and Communication Engineering or a related field.

title: Principal Engineer — Test Strategy
description:
About This Role
**18 years of experience**  

**Skills: Test Strategy, Quality Engineering, Test Architecture, Automation Frameworks, Shift\-Left Testing, CI/CD, AI Testing, Performance Testing, API Testing, Selenium / Playwright, Cloud Testing, Stakeholder Management, Agile / SAFe, Mentoring, DevOps**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for a Principal Engineer — Test Strategy with 18\+ years of experience to define, own, and drive the enterprise\-wide test strategy and quality engineering vision. You will operate at the intersection of technology leadership, quality architecture, and stakeholder engagement — setting the standards, frameworks, and practices that underpin software quality across the organisation. This is a senior leadership role requiring deep QE expertise, strong strategic thinking, and the ability to influence at the highest levels of the organisation.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Define and own the enterprise\-wide test strategy — establishing quality engineering standards, frameworks, and best practices across all delivery programmes.
* Design and govern test architecture — automation frameworks, tooling standards, CI/CD quality gates, and shift\-left testing adoption across engineering teams.
* Lead quality engineering transformation initiatives — driving adoption of AI\-augmented testing, intelligent automation, and modern QE practices across the organisation.
* Establish and maintain QE governance — quality metrics, test coverage standards, reporting frameworks, and release quality sign\-off processes.
* Engage senior stakeholders — CTO, engineering directors, product leadership — presenting quality strategy, risk assessments, and programme quality status with authority.
* Define and oversee non\-functional testing strategy — performance, security, accessibility, and resilience testing standards across enterprise platforms.
* Lead and mentor a community of QE professionals — coaching test leads, automation engineers, and SDETs across multiple delivery teams.
* Contribute to technology strategy — advising on tooling investments, platform quality capabilities, and emerging QE trends including AI / GenAI testing.
* Drive continuous improvement — identifying systemic quality issues, implementing root cause analysis frameworks, and delivering measurable quality improvements.

**What We're Looking For**


* 18\+ years of quality engineering experience with a proven track record of defining and delivering enterprise\-wide test strategies at scale.


* Deep expertise across the full QE spectrum — functional, automation, performance, security, API, and AI / GenAI testing.


* Strong test architecture skills — designing automation frameworks, tooling standards, and CI/CD quality integration across large\-scale delivery organisations.


* Proven ability to define and govern QE standards — quality metrics, test coverage frameworks, and release quality governance.


* Strong leadership and mentoring capability — developing QE talent, coaching senior engineers, and building high\-performing quality engineering communities.


* Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills — influencing CTO, engineering directors, and product leadership with clarity and authority.


* Deep Agile / SAFe delivery knowledge — embedding quality engineering practices across large\-scale Agile programmes.


* Strong understanding of AI / GenAI testing — LLM evaluation, RAG pipeline testing, and AI\-augmented test automation.


* Commercially aware — understanding the business impact of quality risk and using this to drive pragmatic, risk\-proportionate quality decisions.
